title: De Vita et Moribus Philosophorum
title_en: On the Lives and Customs of the Philosophers
author: Walter Burley (Gualterus Burlaeus)

machine_readable_source.format: DjVu XML with scandata page mapping

description: Medieval biographical compendium of ancient philosophers' lives and moral teachings, compiled in the 14th century. This edition presents the Latin text with parallel Old Spanish translation and extensive scholarly notes.
notes: This work was one of the most popular biographical collections of ancient philosophers in the Middle Ages, widely read and translated. It covers pre-Socratic philosophers through Hellenistic period.
format: Critical edition with parallel Latin-Spanish text and scholarly apparatus
